claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Oxybuprocaine is a local anesthetic sodium channel blocker that, at 2.5 uM, is unlikely to kill cancer cells through its annotated target; any modest, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a weak cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic membrane effect shared with other local anesthetics rather than a specific oncogenic pathway.
